verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents an account-wide setting to block routing to providers that may train on your data, plus per-request restriction to providers with a given data policy. The providers page exposes a 'Trains' attribute for each provider. A community user independently confirms that many users enable a global 'ZDR-only' toggle. Missing for 10: training exclusion depends on providers' own self-reported policies with no documented OpenRouter verification or guarantee, and there is no in-depth documentation of how the filter is enforced.
